en.title: Reuse static World3D geometry across Android frame submissions
en.body: The Android project player sends only changed mesh definitions after an acknowledged draw. Camera and HUD changes still arrive every frame. Full packets remain available for recording, retry and EGL recovery.

zh.title: Android 连续提交 World3D 帧时复用静态几何
zh.body: 工程播放器在上一帧绘制成功后只发送变化的网格定义，每帧仍更新相机与 HUD。录制、重试和 EGL 恢复继续使用完整命令。
